citations.review_text: The destruction is the whole thing. You don't flank around the building — you go through it. Supper fun game! You can blow up almost everything. Plus, this game has NO gore, NO bad language,
and NO inappropriate content! This is one of the best games I've played. It's also free! 
I totally recommend this game!

THE FINALS is easily one of the most fun and refreshing FPS games out there. The movement feels great, the gunplay is satisfying, and the destruction makes every match unpredictable. Blowing through walls, floors, and entire buildings to outplay another team never gets old.

The graphics are fantastic, the gameplay is fast-paced, and there's a ton of room for creativity and different playstyles. It's one of those games where even losing can be entertaining because of how chaotic things get.

If you enjoy competitive shooters, THE FINALS is absolutely worth playing. Highly recommend!

One second you’re strategically setting up an ambush with your squad, and the next, someone blows out the entire floor beneath you, sending you falling into a pile of rubble and gunfire. Highly recommended if you love high-stakes action and turning the entire map into your personal weapon!

THE ABSOLUTE PINNACLE OF COMPETITIVE SHOOTERS 👑

If you are not playing THE FINALS, you are genuinely missing out on the greatest evolutionary leap in multiplayer FPS history. I have been eating, sleeping, and breathing this masterpiece, and I can confidently say the genre has a new king.
First of all, the movement and gunplay are buttery smooth. It feels incredibly responsive, rewarding raw mechanical skill and high-IQ positioning like no other game on the market. But the real crown jewel? The fully destructible environments. The destruction isn’t just a visual gimmick; it’s a living, breathing tactical mechanic. Watching a ceiling collapse to drop a cashout station right into your lap completely changes how you approach competitive strategy. It’s pure, unadulterated chaos, but executed with absolute competitive precision.
The art direction, the style, the unreal optimization, and the thunderous sound design make every single match feel like an absolute stadium event. You can feel the love, passion, and unparalleled expertise the developers poured into every single pixel. Embark Studios didn't just make a game; they built an absolute arena phenomenon. 

My only 2 complaints? let me turn down the crowd yelling audio. Your game is so loud.. - and NERF the medium turrets (there should never be more than 1 per team)

It's pretty good, guns and movement feel satisfying, plus the destruction physics are all great. I like the artstyle and the customization options are great. 
Really makes you feel like you're in some frantic takeshi's castle style game show with all the chicanery that can happen in a match.

However, it is pretty sweaty, so be prepared for that. Especially if you have a major skill issue or are prone to getting tilted.
Characters can move between speeds of "heavy tf2" and "gunz the duel." And TTK hovers around 1 second at most. So tracking is generally the main skill here.

Also, the performance and visuals can be iffy, for some it's buttery smooth and crystal clear,
But for others: (me.) It can feel a little sluggish and visually fuzzy, which makes it kinda hard to play or get in the groove. 
This is generally on top of how insanely chaotic the game can get, considering you're able to knock down buildings, blow up walls and generally cause all kinds of chaos. 

Overall, it's pretty good. I'd recommend it if you want a fun semi-competitive FPS with unique sandboxy mechanics.

An absurdly underrated game. Far and away one of the best free to play games available.

Oh, and the level of destruction in the buildings and environments is ridiculously good. It's chaotic, fun and strategic.

Give it a try, they really cooked with this one.

One of the best FPS games I've ever played. The environmental destruction, gunplay is just chefs kiss
An incredibly great game. Great mechanics, gunplay is fantastic, destruction is clean and immersive. Give it a shot, you wont be disappointed.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that the game features fully destructible environments that significantly impact gameplay strategy and map navigation.

citations.review_text: I think this game is very unique everything from it's world aesthetics and game play. All of which I very much approve. It's a fast paced shooter with more destruction that battlefield

The most fun I've had with destruction in any game, hands down. Every time I wonder if the novelty's going to wear off eventually, I end up in a fight for a steal even more dynamic and exciting than the last. And despite being a multiplayer destruction environment, I've never had any desync problems! 

Cashout is a fantastic game mode. It's the best parts of Defusal, KOTH, and CTF rolled together. The bracket-style rounds work really well. It feels like you spend more time winning games (sticking around round-to-round) than losing them (get to requeue for the next game quickly). 

Grab a friend or two and have a blast.

[h1]A fantastic concept and a unique take on the competitive FPS genre.[/h1]

Before getting into it, I should mention that I'm not normally a fan of PvP games. The last competitive shooter I seriously played was the original Black Ops back in the day, and I didn't put many hours into it. Then I watched a friend play The Finals and was completely blown away.

This game is a spectacle.

The destruction, the chaos, the movement, the objective play. It ignited something in me that I didn't realize I was missing. After my first session, I was hooked. I started playing in July and have already put more than 500 hours into it.

That said, you should know what you're getting into.

This is a sweaty game.

You're going to get destroyed for a while before things start clicking. Even after that, you'll still lose and die a lot. The upside is that success feels incredibly rewarding. Every kill feels earned, and every win feels like hitting the lottery. If you're playing with friends, those moments become even better.

[b]The Pros[/b]

[h2]Destruction[/h2]

The destruction is the first thing you'll notice, and it's arguably the best in the business.

Blowing holes through floors to ambush opponents, collapsing buildings onto objective sites, or tossing an explosive canister into a random structure just because you can never gets old. The destruction isn't a gimmick. It's a core part of the gameplay, and it changes the way every match unfolds.

[h2]Skill Expression[/h2]

This is where The Finals really shines.

There are three classes, multiple specializations, dozens of gadgets, different weapons, and countless ways to approach fights and objectives. You can build a character that genuinely matches your personality and playstyle.

More importantly, the skill ceiling is absurdly high. Hundreds of hours later and I'm still learning new things everyday.

[h2]Cosmetics[/h2]

The cosmetic system is excellent.

You can create anything from a tactical operator to the most cursed abomi…

citations.review_text:
The Finals isn't the classic fast pace fps where the only objective is to get as many kills as possible; it redefines the gameplay, you get thrown in a map where everithing can be destroyed (you can kill enemies with flowerpots), you have to adapt to the destruction of the normal route to reach a cashbox, you HAVE to play with your team, otherwise it's almost impossible to win, after you deposit the cashbox inside a cashout you'll have to defend with evrything you've got, even going in front of the enemy while he's stealing it.
You'll have to play some matches in quick cash to learn all the combiantions of abilities and gear that is available but after it will be a lots of fun.
If you're a newbie reading this review, I appreciate your time and my tip is to start with a Medium build, with akm, pyro nade, zipline and defibirllator, don't forget the healing gun to keep your team alive and support it during intense fighting.
I'll wish you best of luck and happy playing The Finals.

THE FINALS – One of the Most Fun and Addictive Multiplayer Games I've Ever Played

THE FINALS is genuinely one of those games that reminds me why I love multiplayer gaming in the first place. In a market filled with repetitive shooters that often feel like copies of one another, THE FINALS manages to stand out with its own identity, offering an experience that feels fresh, chaotic, creative, and incredibly fun.

What makes this game so special is its unique gameplay and mechanics. The fully destructible environments completely change the way you approach every match. Buildings can collapse, walls can be blown apart, floors can disappear, and entire strategies can change within seconds. There is something incredibly satisfying about destroying an entire building just to eliminate an enemy team or completely changing the battlefield to your advantage. The level of environmental destruction adds a layer of unpredictability that very few shooters can offer.

The movement, gunplay, gadgets, abilities, and different character builds make the gameplay even more interesting. Every match feels like a different experience because there are so many ways to approach a situation. You can play aggressively, support your teammates, set traps, defend objectives, or come up with completely unexpected strategies. The freedom to experiment with different loadouts and playstyles keeps things exciting and prevents the gameplay from becoming stale.

But honestly, the biggest achievement of THE FINALS is just how FUN it is. The chaotic team fights, last-second objective steals, unexpected comebacks, insane destruction, and those perfectly timed plays create moments that are genuinely memorable. Even when a match doesn't go your way, there's almost always something entertaining happening.

And that's probably my favourite thing about this game: I KEEP COMING BACK TO IT. No matter how many hours I put into it, I never seem to get bored. I can take a break, come back after a while, and still…

claims.claim: Reviewers report that match-making pairs lower-ranked players against much higher-ranked opponents and high-skill competitors.

citations.review_text:
Man, this sucks to give a negative review because I really LOVE this game. The concept, it's top notch destruction techonology, the mouvement, etc. but playing with friends has become more stressful than fun, don't fall for the trailers where they go "weehee! haha! Throw me!". This won't happen: you go in a game and everyone goes quiet because things are way too tense, even in casual. 

The matchmaking feels relentlessly sweaty, with high-ranked players and smurfs making every games miserable. I feel like I'm ruining my friends' experience because I simply can't keep up. I recently convinced a friend to try the game, and after just two fun matches, we were completely overwhelmed.

Now, I prefer playing alone just to avoid dragging my friends into these lobbies. With SBMM seemingly getting stricter, I'm afraid is getting worse.

I don't have a solution, and I understand matchmaking is complicated. I just want to enjoy this game with my friends without every session feeling like a competitive grind. Right now I can't.

Love to play this game! But the Match making of this game sucks!!! Absolutely sucks! i am a silver player and i am getting queued with Emerald or whatever it is called players and i am getting killed left and right while my team mates play like absolute bronze and silver players the match making in this game sucks but apart from that i love this game.

It's not fun hitting the hidden threshold that just puts emerald players in every single lobby. Remove the sbmm that doesn't even work properly. Would you rather sometimes get stomped due to chance or would you rather get stomped EVERY SINGLE MATCH. This reason alone has driven me and all my friends away from the game.
